subject: Cloud path swap: opt-in instructions and validation
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: ops@stellarpay.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action required: temporary cloud path swap for impacted regions

Hi Team (StellarPayments),

TL;DR: A peering misconfiguration at a cloud provider is causing intermittent packet loss on a subset of egress paths affecting US-west and EU-central. We are also seeing session resets into APAC for a small percentage of flows. To minimize disruption while the provider completes the fix, we can perform a temporary path swap that rehomes your traffic to alternate egress nodes under Redwood's sidecar routing.

What we need from you to opt in (timeline: next 3 hours preferred):
1) Reply to this thread with a single line: "OPT-IN" and confirm the public IPs you allow (or say "no-ip-filter" to use our standard list).
2) If you control TTL for routable DNS entries, please lower TTL to 60s during the swap window.
3) Run the attached quick validation (see cloud-path-swap-checklist.pdf) after we confirm the swap and paste the first 5 lines of the validation log back in this thread.
4) If you have strict certificate pinning, let us know — the path swap preserves TLS certificates and SNI.

Scope: This change is per-account and non-disruptive to TLS — it only changes egress node selection and session routing. We will maintain session affinity where possible; long-lived websockets may briefly reconnect (expected < 45s).

Attachments: cloud-path-swap-checklist.pdf (one-page checklist), sidecar-config template.

We will:
- Apply a targeted sidecar route for StellarPayments in a maintenance window we coordinate below.
- Monitor the validation metrics and provide a verification report within 90 minutes.

If you do not opt in, traffic will continue to take the impaired paths and you may see higher error rates for a subset of requests until the provider completes remediation (ETA unknown).

Please reply OPT-IN or let us know any constraints.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0217

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime

From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@stellarpay.com>

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:03:17 -0500
Subject: Re: Action required: temporary cloud path swap for impacted regions

Thanks Connor — we can opt in. OPT-IN.

Quick clarifying questions before you swap: 
- We enforce certificate pinning on our mobile SDKs; will the path swap change any end-to-end TLS certs or CAs?
- We also rely on sticky sessions for transaction flows — will affinity persist?
- Can you confirm whether the swap will require any change on our side other than lowering TTL?

CC'ing our infra lead Maria (maria.garcia@stellarpay.com). If you need an explicit maintenance window we can offer 11:30–12:30 PDT.

Connor / Neha — internal ops plan:

We are green to proceed with StellarPayments "OPT-IN" for 11:30–12:30 PDT. Steps we will run (from runbook 1A):
- Stage sidecar config: sidecar-config-connor-20270407.json (attached to this thread).
- Push targeted route for account id: acct_0xSELLER (no tenant-wide changes).
- Enable connection tracking override to preserve affinity for existing sessions. Affinity fallback window set to 120s.
- Begin validation: run tcp/http checks and token exchange flow; collect logs to validation-results-connor-20270407.txt.

Connor, you will perform the customer-facing communication and confirm certificate behavior in the thread. Neha, please have the fallback policy ready in case we see increased connection churn (rollback within 10 minutes if > 3% error increase).

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:45:00 +0000
Subject: Update: path swap applied and verification results

Hi Maria / StellarPayments team —

Update: We applied the targeted sidecar path swap at 11:31 PDT for the StellarPayments account (acct_0xSELLER). Summary of results: 
- Swap completed: 11:31 PDT.
- Immediate error-rate delta: <0.8% across API plane (within expected noise).
- Session affinity: preserved for >98% of tracked flows (we applied connection-tracking override).
- TLS/Certs: No change at TLS termination — certificate pinning remains valid; no CA changes.

Attached: validation-results-connor-20270407.txt (first 25 lines attached) and the sidecar config we applied (sidecar-config-connor-20270407.json). The quick checklist (cloud-path-swap-checklist.pdf) shows the step-by-step validation you can run; your first 5 lines of validation should look like the attached snippet.

If you notice any unexpected client reconnections or higher error rates over the next hour, please flag immediately on this thread or open TICKET-8721 and we will roll back within 10 minutes.

Thanks for the quick coordination — we will keep monitoring until the provider confirms the underlying peering fix. We will follow up with a short post-incident note summarizing cause and permanent mitigation by EOD tomorrow.

Connor O'Brien
